about: HD spacecraft made with Meshy (tools/meshy/generate.py --source craft). 'model' is the exterior, 'cockpit' the first-person interior; each 'mesh' is an import slot, baked by tools/meshy/bake_craft.tscn into <slot>_lod.res plus a PBR material. Calibration (set after looking at each model): yaw = degrees to turn the model so its nose points forward; length = metres nose to tail; seat = pilot position and canopy = glass dome radius, both as fractions of the length (x across, y up, z back); engines = thruster positions, same units. Cockpit: offset = where the console sits from the pilot's eyes (metres: x right, y up, z back) and width = its width in metres. Free craft are given to every player. default_cockpit: the craft whose cockpit interior the standard craft borrow in first person.
